_help: Modelled bikes. Put a .glb next to this file and add an entry named after the bike (scooter, sport, raider or hyper): "sport": { "file": "my-bike.glb", "length": 2.0, "yaw": 0, "seat": [0, 0.8, 0.15] }. Front towards -z, y up; yaw turns the model, length (or scale) sizes it; seat is where the rider sits. Nodes called wheel_f / wheel_r / fork (or front wheel, rear wheel, handlebar) turn and steer. Empty = the built-in bikes. See docs/ADD-MODELS.md.
